{{Quote|The New Republic is still in desperate need of supplies, and we aren't always able to locate them through... honest channels. Ka'Pa the Hutt has agreed to sell us these items in exchange for a certain degree of, how shall I say? Amnesty?|Altyr V base's commander, to Mara Jade|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
During the [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sent the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] on a '''mission to negotiate supplies''' from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ka'Pa]]. While her mission took Jade across many places, she succeeded in securing supplies for the New Republic.

==Prelude==
[[File:NewRepublicCommander-MotS.jpg|thumb|left|130px|New Republic Commander helming the mission]]
{{Quote|Also, with Kyle gone, we need you more than ever.|The commander, to Mara Jade before the mission|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
Following the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|evacuation]] of their [[Altyr V base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altyr V]],<ref name="MOTS" /> the New Republic needed supplies during the [[Dark Empire|Imperial]] [[Operation Shadow Hand|counteroffensive]].<ref name="TEGtC" /> In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> the Altyr V base [[Unidentified New Republic commander|commander]], now onboard a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]], spearheaded a mission to utilize fringe connections for resources. New Republic leader [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] hand-selected [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi-in-training]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] for the task. In exchange for supplies now, the New Republic offered [[Ka'Pa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] amnesty and later an ongoing trade relationship.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Ka'Pa's palace intrigue==
{{Quote|You're in no position to negotiate.''"<br />"''«Neither are you, Jade.»|Mara Jade and Ka'Pa as the Hutt's men fill the throne room|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
Upon arriving at [[Ka'Pa's palace]], Jade requested an audience as a New Republic representative, however she was rejected based on her recent Jedi affiliation. In response, Jade infiltrated the palace grounds disguised as a [[Grave Tuskens|Grave Tusken]]. However, Ka'Pa's men saw through her disguise, and many [[Gran/Legends|Gran]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] mercenaries attacked. Jade defeated them and snuck to the palace rooftop where broke through the throne room's glass ceiling.<ref name="MOTS" />

Holding Ka'Pa at [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] point, Jade attempted to negotiate. Ka'Pa called in his men and proposed an alternative deal, that Jade retrieve a [[Global Communications Transponder|surveillance device]] back from his rival crime lord [[Takara]] before he would agree to trade with the New Republic.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Katraasii's many cantinas==
[[File:Motsship.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Jade's ship, the ''Shrike'', docked at Katraasii Spaceport]]
{{Quote|Ka'Pa's agents said Takara's lieutenant Abron Mar hangs out at the spaceport cantina. Hope when I find him, I can convince him to be cooperative... Now if I can just find the cantina, AND avoid all the unsavory characters along the way...|Mara Jade|audio=KatraasiiSpaceportIntro.flac|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
On the behalf of the Hutt, Jade traveled to the planet [[Katraasii]] to apprehend [[Abron Mar]],<ref name="MOTS" /> Takara's right-hand man. She landed her ship, the [[Shrike (Alpha-52 starfighter)|''Shrike'']], and set off to find Mar, searching various [[cantina/Legends|cantinas]] for [[Unidentified Katraasii cantina|Mar's favorite]]. Jade planned to secure information about Ka'Pa's stolen property, but she was instead subdued by Mar and sent to [[Takara's stronghold]], unconscious.<ref name="MOTS" />

==One last monstrous obstacle==
[[File:Takaras_Rancor.png|thumb|left|190px|Takara's rancor]]
{{Quote|I'm in the stronghold, and I've got the GCT device... Pick me up at the dock at the north end...''"<br />"''We're on our way.|Mara Jade and Ka'Pa's agents|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
Jade awoke within scaped from Takara's prison without any weapons and watched by a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]]. After stealing a key and causing a prison break, Jade faced and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Takara's rancor]]. Jade fought through [[Takara's organization]], stole back the transponder, and contacted Ka'P's agents to pick her up. Jade then boarded her ship, retrieved and loaded with supplies by Ka'Pa's men, and returned to the New Republic, thanking Ka'Pa for his generosity.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Mara, you wound me. Perhaps we could just forget all that has happened, and consider the supplies my gift to the New Repuplic's cause.|translated=1|Ka'Pa, to Mara Jade in Huttese|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
After delivering the supplies, Jade was [[Seizure of the Jedi holocron|assigned to guard]] a [[Kaerobani's holocron|holocron]],<ref name="MOTS" /> all while the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war with the Empire]] continued across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEGtC" />

Following Jade's successful job for Ka'Pa,<ref name="MOTS" /> she and her fellow Jedi [[Kyle Katarn]] maintained a good relationship with the Hutt. Ka'Pa also continued to trade with the New Republic, one of the only [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel members]] to do so after Jedi [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] involvement in their member [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] death.<ref name="Hutt">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031106hutt|text=Hutt! Hutt! Hutt! #5}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to negotiate supplies for Ka'Pa the Hutt took place in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" />
